text: おいて　いって　もらおうか！

structure.en: shall I have you do that!

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: もらう after the て-form of a verb means getting someone to do it for you; the おう ending makes it 'I'll have you do it', which is a pushy demand here. おいて いって もらおう = 'I'll have you leave it behind'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after the て-form of a verb says you do it and then go away. おいて いって = 'leave it here and go'.

patterns.name: 〜ようか
patterns.explanation: か after the おう form sounds like 'shall I', and from a tough guy it is a threat dressed up as a suggestion. もらおうか = 'how about I have you do that'.
